From 97830f3c3088638ff90b20dfba2eb4d487bf14d7 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Carlos Llamas <cmllamas@google.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Jan 2024 21:53:46 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] binder: signal epoll threads of self-work
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

In (e)poll mode, threads often depend on I/O events to determine when
data is ready for consumption. Within binder, a thread may initiate a
command via BINDER_WRITE_READ without a read buffer and then make use
of epoll_wait() or similar to consume any responses afterwards.

It is then crucial that epoll threads are signaled via wakeup when they
queue their own work. Otherwise, they risk waiting indefinitely for an
event leaving their work unhandled. What is worse, subsequent commands
won't trigger a wakeup either as the thread has pending work.

Fixes: 457b9a6f09f0 ("Staging: android: add binder driver")
Cc: Arve Hjønnevåg <arve@android.com>
Cc: Martijn Coenen <maco@android.com>
Cc: Alice Ryhl <aliceryhl@google.com>
Cc: Steven Moreland <smoreland@google.com>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org # v4.19+
Signed-off-by: Carlos Llamas <cmllamas@google.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20240131215347.1808751-1-cmllamas@google.com
Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org>

diff --git a/drivers/android/binder.c b/drivers/android/binder.c
index 8dd23b19e997..eca24f41556d 100644
--- a/drivers/android/binder.c
+++ b/drivers/android/binder.c
@@ -478,6 +478,16 @@ binder_enqueue_thread_work_ilocked(struct binder_thread *thread,
 {
 	WARN_ON(!list_empty(&thread->waiting_thread_node));
 	binder_enqueue_work_ilocked(work, &thread->todo);
+
+	/* (e)poll-based threads require an explicit wakeup signal when
+	 * queuing their own work; they rely on these events to consume
+	 * messages without I/O block. Without it, threads risk waiting
+	 * indefinitely without handling the work.
+	 */
+	if (thread->looper & BINDER_LOOPER_STATE_POLL &&
+	    thread->pid == current->pid && !thread->process_todo)
+		wake_up_interruptible_sync(&thread->wait);
+
 	thread->process_todo = true;
 }
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: `drivers/android/binder.c`**
- Added a conditional check in the `binder_enqueue_thread_work_ilocked` function to signal (e)poll-based threads when they queue their own work. 
- The new code checks if the thread is in poll mode, if the current process ID matches the thread's process ID, and if there are no pending tasks to process. If all conditions are met, it calls `wake_up_interruptible_sync(&thread->wait)` to wake up the thread.

### Relationships
- The modification addresses a bug where (e)poll-based threads could wait indefinitely for events when they have queued their own work, leading to unhandled tasks. By implementing the wakeup signal, the patch ensures that these threads are properly notified to handle their work, thus preventing the issue of subsequent commands not triggering a wakeup. This change is crucial for maintaining the responsiveness of the binder driver in scenarios where threads rely on I/O events.
